name: Tobias Cremer - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on tackling barriers to the single market for defence
part_text:
The European Parliament says Europe wastes money on defence because each country buys and builds on its own. It asks for one shared market for defence products, so equipment and parts can move and be bought across borders more easily. It wants simpler rules, common certification, more joint buying, and better access to money for smaller companies. It also wants Ukraine treated as closely as possible as part of this market. This is an opinion; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission and Member States to simplify rules and buy jointly.
- **Who it affects:** Defence companies, especially small ones, national governments, and soldiers using the equipment.
- **What happens next:** The Commission is asked to propose legal changes; Parliament wants to scrutinise them.
